name: Grandma Hettie
bio: The grandmother who left you her handcart in THE HERO'S MERCHANT. Still sends trading tips from Hearthmere.

portrait.subject: a cute chibi old merchant grandmother with a big sun hat, round glasses, a coin pouch belt and a ledger book, sitting on a wooden handcart
portrait.background: painterly HD-2D farming village with fields

request: Dearie! Grandma Hettie here. You've got my cart in THE HERO'S MERCHANT. Write to your old Gran? 🛒
hello: Wonderful! I'll send you price tips.
Buy where it's made, sell where it's wanted. Always.
about: I'm Hettie. Forty years I pushed that handcart across thirteen towns. Now it's yours. Make me proud, dearie!
how: A trading game: buy goods where they're made and sell where they're wanted across thirteen towns, upgrade your cart and help heroes.
tips: Watch prices. Every town has its own wants.
Heroes pay well for the right gear.
chat: The cheese in Hearthmere is up two coins. Scandal!
Saw a hero buy a sword he couldn't lift.
My knees say rain. My ledger says profit.
I still hear the cart wheels in my sleep.
nudge: Prices are good in the next town, dearie!
A hero's looking for supplies. Go!
idle: {ago} and the cart's not moving? Tsk tsk, dearie.
Your goods have sat {ago}. Prices change, you know!
progress: You've got {gold} coins in the purse! Gran is impressed! 🛒

questions.q: What's the best thing to trade?

update: Market news: THE HERO'S MERCHANT updated to v{version}!
